rules.statement: A person can acquire prescriptive title to a land by being in exclusive possession of it as a separate entity for a period of well over 10 years.
rules.supporting_quote: The fact that there were physical boundaries around the corpus also shows that the 3rd defendant did not possess the corpus. The 3rd defendant’s predecessor in title was in possession of the land adjoining to the corpus, which was separated by the said physical boundaries. In the circumstances, the conclusion that the plaintiffs and the 1st defendant had become in exclusive possession of the corpus adverse to the rights of the other co-owners of the larger land and had possessed the corpus as a separate entity of the land for a period of well over 10 years and acquired prescriptive title to the corpus was correct.
